children: Appointment strengthens GYG’s leadership as the Company expands GameGolf and Altus Sports Group, building a broader sports technology ecosystem
PALO ALTO, Calif., Sept. 17, 2026
-- Game Your Game, Inc.
(“GYG” or the “Company”), an AI-powered sports performance technology company, today announced the appointment of Mujtaba Elgoodah as a Strategic Advisor.

The appointment comes as the Company accelerates its growth strategy across two complementary businesses: GameGolf, its AI-powered golf technology platform, and Altus Sports Group (“ASG”), its majority-owned subsidiary focused on talent representation, athlete branding and sports marketing. Elgoodah will serve the Company and ASG in a non-executive, advisory capacity.

Elgoodah brings nearly a decade of experience at the intersection of sports, technology, media and investment. He has worked with leading sports organizations and executives, including the National Basketball Players Association, where he serves as an advisor to the Executive Director. He previously spent five years with the Golden State Warriors, including the team’s 2022 NBA championship season.

Elgoodah is also an investor and advisor across a range of sports and technology ventures, including investments and strategic roles with The Bay Golf Club, Oakland Roots Sports Club and Caledonian Braves Football Club.

“Mujtaba brings a perspective that is particularly valuable to us as we expand ASG,” said Soumya Das, Chairman and CEO of GYG. “He understands the sports business from the athlete, team, league, media and investment perspectives. That combination can help us identify partnerships and opportunities that extend well beyond golf.”

Mujtaba Elgoodah said, “Sports is undergoing a fundamental transformation as technology changes how athletes perform, fans engage and businesses create value. Game Your Game is building a compelling platform across both golf and the broader sports ecosystem, and I am excited to help the team pursue those opportunities.”
About Game Your Game, Inc.
Game Your Game, Inc.

is an AI-powered sports performance technology company. The Company develops and markets the GameGolf KZN AI™ platform — an integrated golf performance ecosystem of proprietary shot-tracking hardware and subscription-based software solutions. The platform leverages advanced GPS tracking, embedded neural network technology, and AI-powered analytics to provide golfers of all skill levels with real-time insights, on-course strategy recommendations, and personalized performance data. Game Your Game's technology has been adopted by golfers in more than 140 countries, with over 36,000 golf courses mapped and an estimated number of more than 300 million shots tracked across the lifetime of its platforms. The Company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. For more information, visit
About Altus Sports Group, Inc.
